particulier.title: Employees and civil servants
particulier.description: Equip your home without waiting until you have the full amount: phone, TV, home appliances, furniture. Your instalments are debited from your salary account.
particulier.condition1: Hold an account with your salary paid into CBAO or CMS
particulier.condition2: Have at least 1 year of service for private-sector employees
particulier.condition3: Be a tenured post-holder for civil servants
particulier.document1: A photocopy of your national identity card
particulier.documentsNote: Further documents may be requested depending on your application.

pro.title: Companies, retailers and institutions
pro.description: Equip your offices and your teams without tying up your cash: IT, furniture, tools, vehicles. One instalment, one invoice.
pro.condition1: Be a legally registered entity in Senegal
pro.condition2: Have at least 1 year of trading activity
pro.condition3: Hold a bank account in the entity's name with CBAO or CMS
pro.document3: Identity document of the manager or legal representative
pro.documentsNote: Further documents may be requested depending on your line of business.

advisor.title: A client adviser guides you
advisor.description: Before any commitment, they tell you the amount you can finance, the application fees, the repayment duration and the terms that apply to your file.
